when.quote: When a customer reports a lost or stolen debit card, there is a risk that other cards in their wallet were also compromised.

starts.note: agent: once the lost or stolen debit card has been frozen or closed, the agent checks for Rho-Bank credit cards and proactively offers a replacement. Order a replacement only if the customer accepts. A customer who already said their credit cards were stolen is asking for it. Run it once per conversation: after the first freeze or close of the lost cards, not again after later closures.

done_when: The credit card check is done (once per conversation, after all lost or stolen debit cards were frozen or closed, including any that could only be frozen). If the customer has credit cards, the replacement offer has been made (or the customer had already named the stolen cards), and for each card one of these is true: it was ordered with agreed shipping, its recorded reason and its own tier fee, and the customer was told the delivery window and reminders; it was explained as not possible now; or it was declined and noted.
